text:
Tess: quick heads-up — QuasarCloud co-hosting the Marketplace Launchpad session on 2026-05-17. We need speaker confirmations, three demo lanes, and a QR-based swag pickup flow. Can we assign owners? :wave:

Alan: I can own the demo lanes and infra. Plan is 3 demo VMs (small/med/large). Need partner SSH keys + model artifacts by EOD Monday.

Linh: I'll own speaker coordination. I need headshots, talk titles, and slide decks by next Thu. Also confirm if any speakers require AV rehearsals.

Kevin: Swag ops here — proposing 200 sticker+lanyard bundles and 80 premium swag boxes for VIPs. QR pickup flow: attendees scan QR -> express code sent to courier table. I can get QR codes printed if I have the final count by Fri. :package:

Maria: Suggest we pre-record 3x 5min fallback demos in case live demos die. Who can record? I can do the voiceover if someone captures the screen.

Alan: @Tess ping partner for S3 presigned URL for artifacts. For infra: will build AMI + docker image. Sample start command for partner demo VM:```bash
docker run -p 8080:8080 --env MODEL_PATH=/mnt/quasar/model.tar.gz redwood/infer-demo:2026-05-01
```Need partner creds to populate MODEL_PATH.

Tess: sounds good. Action list so far:
- Speaker confirm & slides -> @Linh (due 2026-05-10)
- Demo images + partner artifacts -> @Alan (due 2026-05-11)
- Fallback recordings -> @Maria (due 2026-05-14)
- Swag counts + QR codes -> @Kevin (due 2026-05-07)
- Final run-of-show + MC notes -> me (Tess) (due 2026-05-12)

Kevin: Shipping note — small update to courier labels: include "swag pickup desk" and a 4-digit pickup code. Example label text:```text
SWAG PICKUP: MARKETPLACE LAUNCHPAD
DESK: EAST HALL TABLE B
PICKUP CODE: 5721
```Will prototype QR redirect page (short link).

Linh: For speaker queue, let's do 2 backup speakers in case of last-minute drop. @Tess can you share a list of suggested backups?

Tess: I'll DM backups. Also thinking of doing a live 'swap lane' policy — if a demo has >2 errors, we auto-fallback to recorded demo and move on. Adds constraint: we need the recordings uploaded to the event CDN.

Maria: I'll record the fallback videos and upload to S3. Can someone create an event-folder: s3://redwood-events/marketplace-launchpad/recordings/ ?

Alan: Creating that bucket/folder now, will share presigned URLs here when ready. Also will set an ephemeral SSH user for Quasar engineers with a 24h TTL.

SwagBot: :package: Reminder — swag order placed with vendor. ETA to Redwood office: 2026-05-05. Courier pickup scheduled for 2026-05-16 07:30 PT.

Kevin: Nice. For the QR redemption UX: attendees scan -> show code -> staff validate and mark as claimed. I'll share staff checklist and volunteers.

Tess: small checklist for rehearsal call next Tue 10:00 PT: panel run, demo handoffs, AV check, QR page test. Please add any items.

Alan: add: enforce CORS on demo endpoints (we'll test from event network).

Linh: add: slide deck run-through + 2min intro for each demo.

Maria: add: confirm recording 16:9 1080p and captions.

Tess: perfect. I'll send calendar invite and the partner liaison email today. Thanks all :raised_hands:
